**nano.md 0.1.0 — first public release**

![An agent writes plan.md in the terminal pane while the rendered view updates live](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/odysseia06/nanomd/v0.1.0/assets/hero.gif)

A tiny native window for the .md files your AI agents write. Open a file
rendered, `Ctrl+E` for the raw text, `` Ctrl+` `` for a terminal pane in
the file's folder. Reloads when the file changes on disk; conflict guard
when you have unsaved edits.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are unsigned in 0.1.x, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

**Numbers:** 24 MB binary (Windows, CJK font included), ~150 ms cold start to window (30 ms warm),
~68 MB resident with the sample file open.

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).
Roadmap and good-first-issues are pinned in Issues.
